subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Radha will have learnt cooking by the time she will have married.
solution:
The correct answer is 'she will have married'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the future perfect tense in the clause "she will have married" is incorrect.
 
• Instead, the correct tense should be the simple future tense "she marries".
 
• The correct sentence should be: *Radha will have learnt cooking by the time she marries*.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *Radha will have learnt cooking by the time **she marries***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When referring to future events, the simple future tense is often used after expressions like "by the time" to indicate a sequence of events.
 
 
• **Example**: *By the time the movie starts, we will have finished dinner.*
 
 
 
• Using the correct tense ensures clarity and grammatical accuracy in sentences.
